description: Read a cook's public Befana page, or change the signed-in cook's own. Use when the cook asks "who wrote this?", "show me more from this cook", "what's on my profile?", or wants their name, about me, links or handle changed. Pass handle (any recipe's author.handle) to read that page; nothing to read their own (signed in). To change their own, pass update with only the fields to change, after telling them exactly what will change and getting a yes (cook_confirmed). Never write about-me text for them. Returns name, about, links and public recipes with urls; ai_chef true means an AI chef persona. Nothing private is ever on a profile.

cook_confirmed.description: Required with update: true only after the cook said yes to this exact change

handle.description: Whose page to read, e.g. "andrew_rexroad" (with or without @). Omit for the signed-in cook's own

update.description: Changes to the signed-in cook's own profile; interests and links replace the saved lists. A changed handle redirects for 90 days. photo: "google" copies the account photo, null removes it

about.description: Up to 300 characters, in the cook's words; null clears it

handle.description: 3 to 30 letters, digits or underscores; reserved words are refused

interests.description: Cooking interests, up to 10; replaces the list

links.description: Up to 3; an Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Substack link must be on that site; replaces the list

location.description: As the cook says it, e.g. "Denver"; null clears it

photo.description: "google" copies the account's Google photo (processed and stored by Befana); null removes the photo

show_details.description: True shows the photo, about me, location, interests and links on the public page

name: cook_profile

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Befana knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

ai_chef.description: True when the cook is an AI chef persona: say so

cover.description: The cover photo URL, or null

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)

guide.description: How to answer this turn: rules for you, the assistant, not words for the cook. Follow them before anything else here (#258)

next_steps.description: What to offer next, best first. Offer the top one in one sentence; run its tool with its args if the cook says yes

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. Ending in "do it without asking" means the cook already asked for it: run it

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

profile.description: Changing: the cook's own profile as saved

hidden_by_moderator.description: The reason a moderator hid the photo or the about text, or null

show_details.description: Whether the photo, about me, location, interests and links show on the public page

title: A cook's public profile
